label: input-invariants
argv:
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path
import json
from tiplog_py.layout.inputs import load_volumes, raw_classes, compress_classes, make_tree, synthetic_tree, synthetic_classes
tables,mapping,ranked,top,basket,sources=load_volumes(Path("results/data"),"itch_20191230_full_day")
assert len(tables["H-spec"])==8907 and len(ranked)==8906
assert len(top)==len(basket)==100
ranks={p:i+1 for i,p in enumerate(ranked)}
for hierarchy in tables:
    market=tables[hierarchy]["itch/_market"]
    for workload,weight in (("W1",Fraction(8906)),("W2",Fraction(1900)),("W3",Fraction(8906,10))):
        raw=raw_classes("itch/_market",hierarchy,workload,market,tables["H-spec"]["itch/_market"],mapping,ranks,top,basket)
        classes=compress_classes(raw)
        assert Fraction(classes["active_class_weight"])==weight
        assert classes["effective_class_count"]==1
    for partition in (ranked[0],ranked[500],ranked[-1]):
        for workload in ("W0","W1","W2","W3"):
            raw=raw_classes(partition,hierarchy,workload,tables[hierarchy][partition],tables["H-spec"][partition],mapping,ranks,top,basket)
            classes=compress_classes(raw)
            for path,volume in tables[hierarchy][partition].items():
                if volume:
                    before=sum((r["weight"] for r in raw if path in r["topics"]),Fraction())
                    after=sum((Fraction(r["weight"]) for r in classes["effective_classes"] if path in r["positive_topics"]),Fraction())
                    assert before==after
            if workload=="W3":
                names={r["name"] for r in raw}
                assert ("REPLAY_TOP100" in names)==(partition in top)
                assert ("REPLAY_RANDOM100" in names)==(partition in basket)
tree=make_tree("r",{"r":5,"r/a":3,"r/a/b":0})
assert tree.nodes==((None,5,"r"),(0,3,"r/a")) and tree.baseline_stores==2
for shape in ("chain","star","random"):
    for count in (1,4):
        for n in (5,1000):
            tree=synthetic_tree(n,shape,2)
            assert len(tree.nodes)==tree.positive_nodes==n
            assert synthetic_classes(tree,count)["effective_class_count"]==count
metadata=json.loads(Path("/tmp/tiplog-p7-input-functional/metadata.json").read_text())
assert metadata["case_count"]==138
assert all(c["budget_policy"] in ("baseline","sweep") for c in metadata["case_index"].values())
assert all(len(c["effective_classes"])==c["effective_class_count"] for c in metadata["partition_workloads"].values())
print(json.dumps({"status":"passed","source_partitions":8907,"symbols":8906,"market_weights":["8906","1900","8906/10"],"flat_type_projection":"source aggregates equal","compression":"exact per-topic weight preserved","synthetic_effective_classes":[1,4],"small_cases":138},sort_keys=True))
